Signature SNAP used for integrity checking and non-repudiation, it also used to authenticate and authorize the request of API services.Generate Signature SNAPTo generate Signature SNAP you can use this format:Signature type usedAsymetric-SignatureFormatSHA256withRSA (Private_Key, stringToSign)Generate Signature ParametersParameterDescriptionPrivate_KeyA key used for authenticating the request (Generated by merchant)stringToSignTo create a string that will be used to generate a signature.
Formula: HTTPMethod+”:“+EndpointUrl+&quot;:“+Lowercase(HexEncode(SHA256(minify(RequestBody)))) + &quot;:“ + TimeStampHTTPMethodPOST / DELETE / PUT (based on service API)EndpointURLComplete the Endpoint URL including all related URL parameters (Relative path, example: Path in the general information of each API service)
Sample:
SNAP Virtual Account: /v1.0/transfer-va/create-va
SNAP Direct Debit: /v1.0/debit/payment-host-to-host
SNAP QRIS: /v1.0/qr/qr-mpm-generate
SNAP Disbursement: /account/v1.0/account-inquiry-externalRequestBodyData that send to API servicesTimeStampTimestamp request sentFormat: datetime ISO 8601(sample: 2022-12-12T16:00:00+07:00)You can get a signature by following these steps:By using stringToSign a string will be created, the string used for generating a signature.Signature will be generated using algorithm SHA256withRSA with string that has been created, and the private key that owns by merchant.Next, the signature will be encoded by base64_encode.A signature that has been encoded now can be used as the value for X-SIGNATURE on the request header of SNAP API services.Sample Code Generate SignatureSignature Request SampleAPI ServiceCreate VAMethodPOSTEndpoint URL/v1.0/transfer-va/create-vaRequest Body{ &quot;virtualAccountName&quot;: &quot;Jokul Doe&quot;, &quot;virtualAccountEmail&quot;: &quot;jokul@email.com&quot;, &quot;virtualAccountPhone&quot;: &quot;6281828384858&quot;, &quot;trxId&quot;: &quot;abcdefgh1234&quot;, &quot;totalAmount&quot;: { &quot;value&quot;: &quot;12345678.00&quot;, &quot;currency&quot;: &quot;IDR&quot; }, &quot;expiredDate&quot;: &quot;2020-12-31T23:59:59-07:00&quot;, &quot;additionalInfo&quot;: { &quot;billDate&quot;: &quot;2020-12-31T23:59:59-07:00&quot;, &quot;channelCode&quot;: &quot;402&quot;, &quot;billDescription&quot;: &quot;Maintenance&quot; }}Request Body (hashed with SHA256 algorithm)f7e939e8227670a065e4a6f99b42346bfa20724a8e3c775be93b57c95c954dfdTimestamp2022-12-12T16:00:00+07:00String to Sign for Generating SignaturePOST:/v1.0/transfer-va/create-va:f7e939e8227670a065e4a6f99b42346bfa20724a8e3c775be93b57c95c954dfd:2022-12-12T16:00:00+07:00Private  Signature using Private Key with SHA256RSA &amp; Encode with base64 (X-SIGNATURE): API Service - Sample RequestThis is the sample of Create VA request using the signature that has been generated. Details of SNAP create VA can be seen here.Request HeaderSample Request Header SNAP Create VARequest BodySample Request Body SNAP Create VAVerifying Signature SNAPTo validate, the signature that has been generated and sent when request made will be verify by merchant.Verifying Signature SNAP ParametersParameterDescriptionX-SIGNATURE_FROM_FASPAYThe signature used on the SNAP API requestFASPAY_PUBLIC_KEYA key used to verify the signature (generated by Faspay)stringToSignTo create a string that will be used to verify signature.
Formula: HTTPMethod+”:“+EndpointUrl+&quot;:“+Lowercase(HexEncode(SHA256(minify(RequestBody)))) + &quot;:“ + TimeStampHTTPMethodPOST / DELETE / PUT (based on service API)EndpointURLComplete the Endpoint URL including all related URL parameters (Relative path, example: Path in the general information of each API service)
(sample: /v1.0/transfer-va/create-va)RequestBodyData that send to API servicesTimeStampTimestamp request sentFormat: datetime ISO 8601(sample: 2022-12-12T16:00:00+07:00)You can verify the signature by following these steps:By using stringToSign a string will be created, the string used to verify the signature.Next, the signature will be decoded by base64_decode.The decoder result will be verified using algorithm SHA256, with string that has been created, and the public key provided by Faspay.Last, it will return 1 if the signature matches, and 0 if it doesn’t matches.Verifying Signature SampleThis is a sample to verify the signature that used on VA inquiry. SNAP VA inquiry in details can be seen here.SNAP ServiceVA InquiryMethodPOSTEndpoint URL/v1.0/transfer-va/inquiryRequest Body{ &quot;partnerServiceId&quot;: &quot; 88899&quot;, &quot;customerNo&quot;: &quot;12345678901234567890&quot;,&quot;virtualAccountNo&quot;: &quot; 08889912345678901234567890&quot;, &quot;inquiryRequestId&quot;: &quot;abcdef-123456-abcdef&quot; }Public  Body (hashed with SHA256 algorithm)c17a71cdbe89106d0950aa390cffa746e0f94359010789955779fd5817c8e924Timestamp2022-12-12T16:00:00+07:00String to Sign for Verifiying SignaturePOST:/v1.0/transfer-va/inquiry:c17a71cdbe89106d0950aa390cffa746e0f94359010789955779fd5817c8e924:2022-12-12T16:00:00+07:00PreviousSNAPNextSNAP Virtual AccountLast updated 2 months agoGenerate Signature SNAPSignature Request SampleSNAP API Service - Sample RequestVerifying Signature SNAPVerifying Signature SampleCopypublic function generateSignature($data){
 $stringToSign = $data[&#x27;method&#x27;].&quot;:&quot;.$data[&#x27;endpoint&#x27;].&quot;:&quot;.hash(&#x27;sha256&#x27;, $data[&#x27;body&#x27;]).&quot;:&quot;.$data[&#x27;timestamp&#x27;];
 
 $prv_data = file_get_contents(&quot;private.key&quot;);
 $private_key = openssl_get_privatekey($prv_data);
 
 $signature = &quot;&quot;;
 
 openssl_sign($stringToSign, $signature, $private_key, OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256);
 
 return base64_encode($signature);
 }CopyX-TIMESTAMP: 2022-12-12T16:00:00+07:00
